I am an old man, 67 years, and I have been putting my hands in this soil for forty years. I never went to school, but my body knows the seasons. Let me tell you how I will do things this year, same as most years, with small changes.

My 12 mu — I split them like this: 8 mu I plant wheat in winter, then maize right after in summer, same fields. The other 4 mu I keep for cotton, because cotton cannot share ground with wheat-maize, it needs its own field all summer long. This is how my father did it and my neighbors do it.

**Wheat (8 mu, winter):**
Last year wheat gave me maybe 450 jin per mu... no, I mean about 450 kg per mu. Good enough. Before planting I spread one bag of compound fertilizer per mu — 40 kg bag, the 15-15-15 kind from the town dealer. That is my base. Then in spring when the wheat wakes up and greens, I top-dress with urea, about half a bag per mu, maybe 20 kg. So total nitrogen, I count roughly 15 kg per mu from both. I water maybe three times — after planting, at jointing in spring, and at grain-filling. The well is there, so water is not so expensive, just electricity and my time. Spray for aphids and rust, usually twice is enough. I use improved seed, the kind my neighbor Old Wang buys — Jimai something, I forget the number, but the dealer knows.

**Maize (8 mu, summer, after wheat):**
After I cut wheat in June, I put maize right in, no plough, just the seeding machine goes through the stubble. No-till saves me money and the ground stays moist. One bag compound fertilizer at planting, then when maize is knee-high I side-dress urea, about 25 kg per mu because maize is a hungry crop, eats more than wheat. Water twice if rain is not enough — July and August. Spray once for borer. Hybrid seed always, Zhengdan or Xianyu, whatever the shop has. Last year I got about 550 kg per mu.

**Cotton (4 mu):**
Cotton is more trouble than the grain crops, but the price is better per jin. I plough this field properly in spring because cotton likes loose soil. One bag compound at planting, then topdress urea twice — once at squaring, once at flowering, maybe 15 kg each time. Water three times from the well. Pesticide I must spray many times for bollworm and aphid — five or six times through the summer, cotton pests are stubborn. Improved seed, the Bt kind, it helps with bollworm so I spray less than before. I expect about 250 kg of seed cotton per mu — that is what I got last two years.

I do not like to waste money on fertilizer, but I would rather put a little extra than see yellow leaves and small ears. A bad harvest hurts the whole family. So I stay close to what worked last year.
